text:
clare_marketing: Quick heads-up team — we've locked MistralBio as the customer spotlight for next week's launch. Need to finalize quotes, legal clearance, and webinar routing. Interview set for Wed 3:00pm PT. Legal needs final quote wording by EOD Tue. Who can own the quote curation + approvals?

caleb_content: I can curate quotes. I'll add 3 polished options to the doc by EOD today and include the consent email template. Draft here: https://docs.google.com/draft/mistral-launch (private)

caleb_content: Draft quote candidate A (raw):
```\"Redwood reduced our tail latency by 4x and cut token spend by ~38% — better UX and much lower cost.\"```

amy_legal: A few legal items: please avoid tildes (~) in published copy; either say "approximately 38%" or provide exact figures. Remove subjective claims like "better UX" unless the customer explicitly signs off. We also require an explicit signed approval (email reply OK) for any quoted attribution. Ping me when the doc is shared for review.

caleb_content: Will provide three sanitized variants plus the raw one for reference, and add a consent checkbox language snippet for the customer to use when replying.

jamal_prod: Important — confirm bench provenance before we publish any hard numbers. Snapshot from our run:
```
model: redwood-v1-medium
hardware: 1xA100-40GB
sequence: 1024 tokens
latency p95 before: 85ms -> after optimizations: 21ms (4.0x)
cost per token estimate before: $0.00012 -> after: $0.000074 (~38% reduction)
```
I'll add the harness link and exact run dates to the doc. We should include a short caveat about workload/test setup.

amy_legal: Good — include the test harness link and exact bench dates. Legal will still need written customer confirmation for the final quoted phrasing. I can fast-track redlines if @mentioned.

caleb_content: Draft consent note (to paste into the doc and send to customer):

"Hi [Name], thanks again for working with us. We'd love to include a short attributable quote from you in our launch blog and webinar promotions. Please confirm the following quote (or reply with edits):

\"Redwood reduced our tail latency by 4x and reduced token costs by approximately 38% in our internal tests.\"

By replying 'I approve' you consent to this quote being used in Redwood marketing materials and webinar promotion. This approval covers the embargoed publish window of [publish date] through [x weeks]. If you need the quote changed or removed later, reply to this thread or contact legal@redwood.com.

Thanks,
Caleb / Redwood Marketing"

amy_legal: That looks good — add the exact embargo/publish date before sending and copy me on the outbound. I'll prepare a one-click redline for minor wording fixes.

clare_marketing: Proposed timeline: 
- Mon (today): Caleb -> 3 curated quote options + consent template in doc.
- Tue EOD: Legal redlines posted.
- Wed 10:00am PT: Final legal check and customer approval status.
- Wed 3:00pm PT: Recorded customer interview.
- Thu AM: Blog embargo set and webinar registration goes live.

Please call out blockers now. :thumbsup: 

caleb_content: Assigning tasks in the doc and pinging customer now. Also adding SF campaign tag for Sylvie.

sylvie_sales: If this becomes a co-presented webinar, route demo/SQL leads to Sales Ops -> Sylvie + AE team under SF campaign MISTRAL_LAUNCH. I'll add a registration gating question to capture purchase intent ("Are you evaluating vendor solutions in the next 3 months?") and a campaign hidden field. Will share campaign id when ready.

calendar-bot: Event created: \"MistralBio Interview\" Wed 3:00pm PT (organizer: clare_marketing). Invitees: caleb_content, jamal_prod, amy_legal, sylvie_sales, [Mistral contact].

clare_marketing: Amy, flag any legal hard stops here by EOD so we can reschedule interview if needed.

amy_legal: Reading the doc now; will have redlines by 8:00pm PT. Any customer pushback on the phrase "4x" vs "~4x" — we prefer precise phrasing tied to the test harness.

caleb_content: Copy — will use exact phrasing tied to the bench and include the test caveat. I'll update the consent email and ping once customer replies.

clare_marketing: Closing loop later today with a short checklist in the doc and a final publish plan. If anyone needs to reassign, DM me.
